purpose: Backfill explicit modern source-governance fields for a geographically corrective, near-term-active P1 cohort while preserving canonical, monitoring and held-source state.

selection.method: P1 selection diagnostic ranked active 90-day horizon, active non-completed dependencies and total dependency, then imposed source-scope integrity, regional/domain balance and governance-information value; not mechanical top-N

opec.finding: OPEC press releases are authoritative informational references, while OPEC terms restrict reproduction/distribution and storage in shared electronic archives/databases without written authorisation; occasional attributed internal/research use does not establish production automation permission.

japan_esri.finding: ESRI publishes exact GDP release dates/times and warns the schedule may change. Cabinet Office content reuse is broadly permitted with attribution and is compatible with CC BY 4.0, but content reuse terms do not independently authorise unrestricted polling.

rbi.finding: RBI directly publishes FY2026-27 multi-day MPC meeting windows. Current website policy protects content and prohibits unauthorised reproduction/distribution/commercial use while reserving access restrictions; no production automation permission is inferred.

sarb.finding: SARB publishes 2026 MPC announcement dates/times. Its disclaimer prohibits copying/reproduction/adaptation/publication/distribution without prior written consent and reserves access/data-format controls.

mexico_constitution.finding: The Cámara publishes the current Constitution; Mexican Federal Copyright Law Article 14(VIII) excludes legislative, regulatory, administrative and judicial texts and official translations from copyright protection, subject to fidelity to official text. That does not itself clear automated polling.

un_general_assembly.finding: UNGA publishes the provisional 81st-session high-level schedule. General UN website terms limit copying to personal non-commercial use without redistribution/compilation/derivative rights, so the route remains manual informational provenance with automation held.

set.governance_backfill_basis: OPEC press releases are authoritative informational references, but OPEC terms restrict reproduction/distribution and storage in shared electronic archives or databases without written authorisation; occasional attributed internal/research use is not production automation permission.

ESRI's official GDP schedule supplies exact source-native release dates and 08:50 JST times and warns dates may change; Cabinet Office reuse terms support attributed factual reuse, while production polling remains endpoint-review-required despite existing pilot evidence.

RBI's official press release supports FY2026-27 multi-day MPC meeting windows, including 5-7 October and 2-4 December 2026, but does not supply a separate decision-release clock time. RBI website policy restricts unauthorised reproduction/distribution/commercial use and reserves access controls, so automation remains held.

SARB's official MPC webcast page supplies 2026 announcement dates and 15:00 presentation times, but its disclaimer prohibits copying/reproduction/adaptation/publication/distribution without prior written consent and reserves access controls; verification remains rights-held manual only.

The Cámara's current constitutional text is authoritative for the 8 September budget-submission and 15 November approval deadlines; Mexican Federal Copyright Law Article 14(VIII) excludes legislative texts from copyright protection, but no automated retrieval permission is inferred from that legal status.

UNGA's official 81st-session pages support the session opening and provisional High-level Week schedule, but general UN website terms limit copying to personal non-commercial use without redistribution/compilation/derivative rights; automation remains held and provisional status must be preserved.

WSSRC-EL-BR-001.reason: The TSE electoral-calendar source is not the proper provenance basis for the constitutionally grounded 5 January 2027 presidential inauguration/start date.

WSSRC-CB-009.reason: The current registered SNB decisions/history URL does not directly support the forward monetary-policy assessment schedule described by the source record; repair source scope before governance backfill.
